source: Table from the 'SoftServe OCI/AIDP expertise use cases' session (KN7X2Y65NX), pasted by Alex 2026-10-13. 15 cases; slide 6 keeps the nine that are not database- or ERP-centric (Option 3's definition); cases 8-13 are named in the key line.

cases.name: Digital twins for sites and factories
cases.problem: redesign sites and factories on paper and on site; each change takes months.
cases.solution: A live 3D twin tests changes before building: siting from 18 months to 8 weeks.

cases.name: Physics simulation models
cases.problem: wait hours per physics simulation, so every design change delays the product.
cases.solution: Physics-ML models on GPUs: simulation from 4 h to 5 min, downtime −15%.

cases.name: GPU workload tuning
cases.problem: run AI and simulation jobs on untuned cloud GPUs; the bill keeps climbing.
cases.solution: Workloads moved to dedicated clusters and tuned: run time halved, cost about −50%.

cases.name: Simulation-first robotics
cases.problem: lack real training footage, so each robot deployment waits months.
cases.solution: Trained in simulation, tuned on 15 min of real video: recall from 49% to 93%.

cases.name: Industrial IoT and production analytics
cases.problem: can't explain losses with machine and test data spread over ~10 systems.
cases.solution: One analytics layer over factory data: energy −10%, testing productivity +10–15%.

cases.name: Energy production and emissions
cases.problem: tune well pumps and gas lift by hand, so wells under-produce.
cases.solution: ML on production data tunes pumps and gas lift: +45,000 barrels a month.

cases.name: Seismic and asset-image deep learning
cases.problem: read seismic volumes and inspection images by hand; findings come late.
cases.solution: Deep learning segments 3D seismic data and flags corrosion in images (PoC level).

cases.name: Generative content on brand data
cases.problem: produce labels and visuals by hand, so campaigns wait on designers.
cases.solution: Models trained on brand assets generate labels and images at volume, live in production.

cases.name: Vision on aerial imagery
cases.problem: inspect properties visit by visit, so underwriting data is thin and costly.
cases.solution: Vision models read 12 property attributes from aerial images for 25,000+ sites.

key:
Call (the expertise review's verdict on Oracle demand): Pursue = a live Oracle lead or priority campaign · Proof only = strong SoftServe proof, no Oracle lead · Park = thin proof or no demand signal.
Also found, data- and ERP-centric (Option 2 territory): supply-chain agents on ERP data · CFO finance analytics · warehouse migrations · a governed semantic layer · banking risk data · document Q&A.
notes:
Source: the 'SoftServe OCI/AIDP expertise use cases' session (13 Oct), 15 cases; this slide keeps the nine that are not database- or ERP-centric.
PURSUE. Digital twins: TerraPower nuclear siting from 18 months to as little as 8 weeks (client release); Global Switch data-centre twin (client release); Continental factory twin with a maintenance co-pilot, -10% maintenance expected. Live Oracle leads: BMW smart factory on Oracle Edge + Omniverse ($0.5M+), Orange Omniverse ($100K). Physics simulation: Krones from 4 h to 5 min, downtime -15%, Microsoft manufacturing award 2026 (runs on Azure); Shell reactor models up to 10^6x faster (joint papers). Lead: OMV (NVIDIA PhysicsNeMo), which Oracle rates low priority. GPU workload tuning: R&D hardware-acceleration practice, run time halved, cloud cost about -50% (typical results claimed, no named client); fits Oracle's AI-cost laser campaign O3 (189+ accounts, priority); needs one named client; overlaps Option 2's AI running-cost reduction service.
PROOF ONLY. Robotics: Toyota Material Handling, model post-trained on 15 min of warehouse video, 99.5% precision and 92.8% recall vs 49.4% recall from simulation alone; AES solar robot on L40S, timeline -2-3 months. Industrial IoT: semiconductor-equipment maker, test data from ~10 systems, testing productivity +10-15%; Printing Planet compressor energy -10%, waste -50%+. Energy: Vital Energy ML for well pumps and gas lift, +45,000 barrels a month (~$4M in six months); a toy maker's carbon data model; Budderfly energy baselines. SoftServe's strongest vertical, not an Oracle priority (banking, aviation, government are).
PARK. Seismic: 3D seismic segmentation PoC for a US oil major; oil and gas ML platform; corrosion-detection PoCs for ABS and Pinnacle. Generative content: Avery label generation live on NVIDIA models; a retailer's image and video model trained from scratch (Google Cloud); no Oracle demand signal. Aerial vision: an insurer's 6-week PoC deriving 12 property attributes for 25,000+ locations; Cisco award for video-footage search (no client).
DATA- AND ERP-CENTRIC (AIDP, Option 2 territory): supply-chain and inventory agents on ERP data (pursue per deal; SoftServe's Inventory Management Teammate; closest public asset to Oracle's first AIDP target, EBS, 123 accounts), CFO finance and profitability analytics (pursue per deal with Oracle's Deep Insights; proof is reporting-level), migrations onto a lakehouse (pursue: Oracle campaigns on old warehouses, 150, and data movement, 222; Blis 5 PB moved in under 4 months, bill -20%), governed data foundation and semantic layer (pursue: Oracle's priority Lakehouse campaign, 225; BDUK, Shawbrook), banking risk and compliance data (pursue: banking is an Oracle priority industry; BNY's OCI landing zone is an internal credential), research and Q&A over documents (pursue: Oracle's largest AIDP campaign, unstructured data, 238; McGill and Partners 6 h to 10 min).
